newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian Air Force jet crashes, pilot ejects.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian Air Force jet crashes, pilot ejects.

text.p: A Brazilian Air Force F-5 jet fighter crashed during a training flight in southern Brazil on Friday and the pilot ejected, an Air Force spokesman said.
The accident happened at 3.20 p.m. (1720 GMT) when the F-5 was heading back to Canoas air base near the town of Santa Maria in Rio Grande do Sul state.
The cause of the crash was not known, the spokesman added.
An air search for the pilot was under way, local media reported.
